title: Game whipped up for bicycle trainers called Mt. Crankmore
author: dremspider
selftext:
I built this because my kids always want to play on my indoor bike and I feel like there isn't a lot of great games out there that are kids friendly even though.  I am amazed how easy Claude was able to figure out how to connect to the trainer.  I am out of tokens now, but will continue developing it as I get more.  
  
Going all in on sprites.  I built this with Claude Code and Pixellab.al.  This is meant to be played on a bicycle trainer, however it works but is kinda lame with a keyboard.  If anyone has a bicycle trainer I would love it if you try it and report back what trainer you have tried it with.  So far I tested only with Wahoo kicker v2 and a Zwift Ride with bluetooth and wifi.    


[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=D5y-eMLlLx4](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=D5y-eMLlLx4)

comments.author: SouthCentralMenace
comments.body: This is dope! Ive actually been working on a game that connects to my Wahoo Kickr Core and Zwift controllers. I was wondering if anybody else was doing something with an indoor trainer. Ill try this out
